  "customer_support_rating": 4,
  "recommendation_score": 9,
  "pros": [
    "Extensive application catalog and seamless SSO integrations.",
    "Robust security features and adaptive MFA policies.",
    "Cloud-native architecture simplified deployment and management."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Initial setup for complex, custom applications required significant effort.",
    "Cost can be substantial for a very large enterprise with many users.",
    "Reporting and auditing features could sometimes be more intuitive."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This SME mar tech, responsible for organization-wide SSO in a large IT services company, found Okta to be a powerful and effective solution. They appreciated its comprehensive app integrations and strong security capabilities, which were a significant upgrade from their previous solution. While implementation for highly customized systems presented some challenges, the overall benefits in streamlining access and enhancing security over two years were clear."
}
